h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Parbhani

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Parbhani

items.pText: Much of Parbhani district sits on the black cotton soil of the Marathwada plateau. It is good farmland, but it swells when it soaks up monsoon rain and shrinks and cracks when it dries in summer. That movement can tilt or loosen a playground post set into it without the right base, so the ground deserves attention before the equipment is chosen.

FunPlay Systems manufactures outdoor playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 410 km from Parbhani. We send it by road within Maharashtra, where we have also installed a playground for Raymond in Thane. Our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment at schools, colleges, societies and public gardens. Send us photos of your ground, ideally one taken in the dry season, along with the size and the age group. We will suggest an installation method and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Grouting into black soil needs pits that are wide and deep enough to reach firmer ground, filled with concrete that holds the leg steady as the soil moves. Where the top layer is deep, a self-standing base on a levelled concrete pad can be the more stable choice. We decide this once we see your site.
Drainage matters too. Water that collects around the posts makes the soil swell unevenly, so slope the play area slightly and give the water somewhere to go. Check that pieces such as

items.q: Can playground equipment be installed on black cotton soil in Parbhani?
items.a: Yes, with the right base. We use deeper grouting or a self-standing installation on a concrete pad, depending on how deep the soft layer is.

items.q: Why do some playground posts tilt after the monsoon?
items.a: Black soil swells when wet and shrinks when dry. Posts set in shallow pits can move with it. A proper foundation and good drainage prevent most of this.

items.q: Do you supply Parbhani and other Marathwada towns?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to Parbhani, Nanded, Latur and Jalna, and our installation team or a dealer installs the equipment.
